🚨 We're Hiring | Financial Analyst | Noida 🚨

Project Pulse is hiring on behalf of a leading EdTech company for the role of Financial Analyst – Office of Strategy.

If you have strong analytical skills and experience in financial planning, modeling, and business strategy, this is an excellent opportunity to work on high-impact projects in a fast-growing organization.

📍 Location: Noida
👩 Eligibility: Only Female Candidates
💼 Experience: 3–5 Years
🎓 Qualification: MBA (Finance) / CA / CFA Preferred

Key Responsibilities: 
• Financial Analysis & Financial Modeling
• Budgeting, Forecasting & Planning
• Business & Market Research
• Fundraising & Strategic Projects
• Reporting, Dashboards & Management Presentations

Required Skills: 
✔ Advanced MS Excel & PowerPoint
✔ Financial Modeling & Business Analysis
✔ FP&A / Corporate Finance / Strategy Experience
✔ Power BI (Preferred)

📩 Apply Now: projectpulsecareer@gmail.com

Please mention "Financial Analyst – Noida" in the subject line while sending your resume.

Feel free to Like, Comment, Share, or Tag someone who may be interested.
